sentences.text: 7. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, this Court is of the view that the appellant has made out a case for bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Anuj Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: The Court below erred in rejecting the bail application.

sentences.text: The impugned order suffers from infirmity and illegality and the same is liable to be set-aside and the appeal is liable to be allowed.

sentences.text: 8. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and the impugned order rejecting the bail application of the appellant is set-aside.

sentences.text: In the aforesaid F.I.R. two persons namely Anuj Yadav (applicant herein) and the wife of Prakash Yadav have been nominated as named accused whereas an unknown person has also been arraigned as an accused..
sentences._hearing_file: Anuj Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 April, 2025.json

sentences.text: However, subsequent to aforesaid F.I.R., applicant solemnized marriage with the prosecutrix on 08.07.2024 in accordance with Hindu Rites and Custom.

sentences.text: Consequently, the prosecutrix became the legally wedded wife of applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Anuj Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 April, 2025.json

sentences.text: By reason of above, the prosecutrix started residing with applicant as his legally wedded wife.
sentences._hearing_file: Anuj Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 April, 2025.json

sentences.text: Bonafide of the parties is also explicit from the fact that the marriage of parties has also been registered under the U.P. Marriage Registration Rules 2017.
sentences._hearing_file: Anuj Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 April, 2025.json

sentences.text: Photocopy of the marriage registration certificate has been brought on record and is at page 53 of of the paper book.
sentences._hearing_file: Anuj Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 April, 2025.json

sentences.text: On the above premise, the learned counsel for applicant submits that once the marriage of the parties has been registered under the relevant rules, therefore, there is a statutory presumption regarding legal and valid marriage of the parties.
sentences._hearing_file: Anuj Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 April, 2025.json

It is thus urged by the learned counsel for applicant that in view of the aforementioned subsequent developments, the criminality,

sentences.text: In the peculiar facts and circumstances of this case, we are of the considered view that the conviction and sentence of the appellant who is maternal uncle of the prosecutrix deserves to be set aside in view of the subsequent events that have been brought to the notice of this Court.

sentences.text: We have been informed about the custom in Tamilnadu of the marriage of a girl with the maternal uncle.

opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
As such, they are living together as husband and wife.
Once the marriage of the parties has been registered under the U.P. Marriage Registration Rules 2017 then there is a statutory presumption regarding legal and valid marriage of the parties.
In view of aforesaid subsequent developments, the criminality, if any, committed by accused/applicant now stands washed off.
As such, no useful purpose shall be served in prolonging the criminal prosecution of accused/applicant.
As such, in case the criminal prosecution of applicant is allowed to continue, a happy family comprising of accused/applicant and the prosecutrix shall stand broken.
